text: Meet the 2020 Ford Mustang, an iconic blend of heritage and modern muscle. With aggressive styling and a powerful presence, it's more than just good looks. Let's dig into what makes it roar. Under the hood, you've got a choice, but the 5.0-liter V8 is the real star, pushing out 460 horsepower. It delivers a thrilling top-end rush, making every ride an adventure. Rear-wheel drive gives you that classic Mustang feel. It sticks in the corners and rockets out of them, with a six-speed manual that truly connects you to the road. Stack it against the Chevy Camaro's 455 horsepower, and the Mustang holds its own with a balance of power and agility. Choices, choices. Inside, it's all about the driver. Supportive seats and intuitive controls make it just as comfortable for commute as it is on a track day. And if you're into tuning, the Mustang offers plenty of potential. From exhaust upgrades to turbocharging, it's a playground for modifications. So, would you choose the pure muscle of the Mustang? Or do you swing another way? Let us know what drives you.
